```python
'''
FILENAME: main.py
'''
import tkinter as tk
from password_checker import PasswordStrengthChecker
class PasswordStrengthGUI:
    '''
    DOCSTRING: Manages the GUI for password strength checking.
    '''
    def __init__(self):
        self.checker = PasswordStrengthChecker()
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Password Strength Checker")
        self.label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Enter Password:")
        self.label.pack()
        self.entry = tk.Entry(self.root, show="*")
        self.entry.pack()
        self.button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Check Strength", command=self.check_password)
        self.button.pack()
        self.result_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="")
        self.result_label.pack()
        self.root.mainloop()
    def check_password(self):
        '''
        DOCSTRING: Checks the password strength and updates the result label.
        '''
        password = self.entry.get()
        score, rating = self.checker.evaluate_password_strength(password)
        self.result_label.config(text=f"Strength: {rating} (Score: {score})")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    PasswordStrengthGUI()
```

password_checker.py
```python
'''
FILENAME: password_checker.py
'''
import re
class PasswordStrengthChecker:
    '''
    DOCSTRING: Evaluates the strength of a given password.
    '''
    def evaluate_password_strength(self, password):
        '''
        DOCSTRING: Evaluates the password and returns a strength score and rating.
        '''
        score = 0
        if len(password) >= 8:
            score += 1
        if re.search(r"[A-Z]", password):
            score += 1
        if re.search(r"[a-z]", password):
            score += 1
        if re.search(r"[0-9]", password):
            score += 1
        if re.search(r"[!@#$%^&*(),.?\":{}|<>]", password):
            score += 1
        if score == 5:
            rating = "Very Strong"
        elif score == 4:
            rating = "Strong"
        elif score == 3:
            rating = "Moderate"
        elif score == 2:
            rating = "Weak"
        else:
            rating = "Very Weak"
        return score, rating
```
